skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of cost accounting, distinguish between cost accounting, management accounting, and financial accounting.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Role and Position of Cost Accounting
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Identify the role and position of cost accounting within an organization and its relationship with other functional departments.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Types of Costs and Product Costs
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Differentiate between various types of costs and product costs.
Compare and contrast different methods of determining costs.
Apply appropriate methods for determining costs based on the specific characteristics of business operations.
Prepare production cost reports to assess cost control and make decisions.
Explain production costs to enhance operational efficiency.
Master the skills of writing reports.
Master the skills of independent work and teamwork.
Demonstrate self-management and take responsibility for personal learning outcomes.
